pitfalls: The repo also ships minicpm_wi4b32_wi8_afp32_gpu_opt.litertlm (same recipe, optimized for GPU execution) and MiniCPM5-1B_dynamic_wi8_afp32.litertlm (dynamic weight-only INT8, static prefill memory allocation) — separate artifacts, not this card (card L28-L29).

Runtime floor: since the re-pack of 2026-10-10 UTC (Hub commit d417eaa3) the file needs litert-lm 0.18.0 or newer (tested on 0.18.0) and carries LiteRT-LM's official minicpm5 configuration: thinking is off unless enable_thinking is true, the reasoning arrives on the thought channel, and tool calls are parsed by the runtime (card L27).

Mac speed (litert-lm benchmark -p 256 -d 256 --runs 3 --cache no, Apple M4 Max): this file 533 / 102.8 tok/s prefill / decode on CPU and 5,128 / 238.9 on GPU with litert-lm 0.15.0; the table entered the card on 2026-10-09 UTC (commit f6a837aa), a day before the files were replaced (d417eaa3), so its rows are of the earlier bytes, as is the note that this file also runs on 0.15.0 (card L120-L137).
Quantization benchmark in the card compares the FP (bf16) baseline and the W4 model with thinking mode turned off to reduce context usage (card L31-L44).

The MiniCPM5-2B conversion (cards minicpm5-2b-int4/-int8) followed this artifact's packaging as of the first draft (2026-09-08: verbatim chat_template.jinja on the jinja path) — see premises; the file has been re-packed since (card L27).

Conversation preface with tools and no messages: LiteRT-LM renders the chat template with an empty message list, and the template reads messages[0] without checking that the list is non-empty, so the render fails with 'Failed to apply template: undefined value' when the preface is prefilled at creation (prefillPrefaceOnInit, default false; creating the conversation fails) and in the preface render (renderPrefaceIntoString and its C++ and C API forms); the same with extra context (such as enable_thinking) and no messages, and in the preface render with an empty preface (run in the runtime on one Qwen3 template; the other templates rendered with minijinja 2.14 and jinja2); read in the source of LiteRT-LM 0.17.0, 0.18.1 and main, measured with the 0.18.1 PyPI package through its C API on these files' template text; the default path, where the first message is rendered with the preface, is not affected (the 0.18.1 Python API and CLI expose neither the flag nor the preface render); a system message or any initial message in the conversation config avoids it (card L101).
